content_md:
Reading Vitalik new thudpost on world computer

The gist: the "world computer" isn't a faster blockchain, it's a blockchain plus the rest of the crypto stack. Chains give shared state and ordering but can't keep secrets; ZK, MPC, FHE, and obfuscation supply the missing half. L1 stays simple and verifiable; privacy stops being a bolt-on.

[Vitalik, "The cryptographic world computer"](https://vitalik.eth.limo/general/2026/09/27/the_cryptographic_world_computer.html)
